entries.name: Unconvincing Glide
entries: You can fly, but only while everyone is watching. If no creature can see you, you immediately begin to walk instead.

entries.name: Weather Sense
entries: You always know whether it is currently raining on you.

race.name: Fake Tunnelkin
entries: Generations underground have left the tunnelkin with several dubious gifts:

items: You can dig a hole slightly faster than someone with a better shovel.
You have advantage on checks to remember which way is down.

entries.name: Household Camouflage
entries: As an action, you can transform into a piece of furniture from the Convincing Furniture table. You gain no benefit from this; the furniture is not convincing.

entries.caption: Convincing Furniture
rows: A coat rack wearing your own coat
A chest that giggles when opened

entries.name: Dust Step
entries: Once per day you can teleport a few feet, kicking up an unconvincing amount of dust.

entries.name: Grit Skin
entries: You have resistance to paper cuts.
